review_candidates.title: English Customer support agent -Morning shift
review_candidates.description: Company Description ETISAL International Group is a leading Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) company serving clients across the Middle and Far East. The organization focuses on delivering high-value, customized outsourcing solutions that address each client’s unique business needs and help them concentrate on their core operations. With strong attention to cultural nuances, industry best practices, and global coverage, ETISAL International aims to provide consultative and innovative services. The company emphasizes transparency, flexibility, integrity, and a passion for service, continually enhancing its management and operational standards. ETISAL International values human capital and leverages advanced technologies to exceed client expectations and deliver first-class quality. Role Description The English Customer Support Agent – Outbound – Morning Shift is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Maadi. In this position, the agent will make outbound calls to customers, provide information about products or services, and ensure that inquiries and issues are handled promptly and professionally. Daily responsibilities include addressing customer questions, resolving basic problems or concerns, documenting interactions accurately in the system, and following established procedures and scripts while maintaining high service quality. The agent will collaborate with team members and supervisors to meet performance targets, follow up with customers when needed, and contribute to overall customer satisfaction. This role requires consistent attendance during morning shift hours and adherence to company policies and guidelines. Qualifications Strong customer-facing skills, including Customer Support, Customer Service, and a focus on Customer Satisfaction. Clear and professional Communication skills in English, both spoken and written. Ability to perform basic Troubleshooting, identify customer needs, and provide appropriate solutions or escalations. Previous experience in call centers, BPO, or outbound customer support is preferred. Comfort working on-site in Qesm El Maadi and maintaining reliability for morning shift schedules. Good typing skills and familiarity with CRM or call center systems is an advantage. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage time effectively, and handle repetitive tasks with attention to detail.

review_candidates.title: Account Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Css is a growing organization focused on delivering reliable, high-quality services to its clients across diverse industries. The company emphasizes customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships. Team members work in a collaborative environment where initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement are encouraged. Css offers opportunities for professional development and values individuals who contribute to positive client relationships and sustainable business growth. The organization is committed to maintaining a respectful, inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive. Role Description The Account Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of client accounts. On a day-to-day basis, the Account Manager will serve as the primary point of contact for clients, respond to inquiries, and ensure that services are delivered according to agreed standards and timelines. The role includes monitoring account performance, preparing reports, and identifying opportunities to expand services or improve client satisfaction. The Account Manager will coordinate closely with internal teams to address client needs, resolve issues, and support project execution. This position also involves participating in meetings, negotiating terms within defined guidelines, and contributing to strategic planning for key accounts. Qualifications Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, handle day-to-day communications, and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. Experience in account management, sales, or customer success, including tracking performance metrics and preparing regular account reports. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple accounts simultaneously. Effective verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in Arabic is a strong advantage. Comfort working on-site in Cairo and collaborating with cross-functional teams to address client needs and resolve issues promptly. Analytical mindset with the ability to understand client requirements, identify growth opportunities, and support negotiation of service terms. Proficiency with common office and productivity tools (e.g., CRM systems, spreadsheets, presentation software). Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Previous experience in a service-oriented or B2B environment is preferred.
